tasks.label: Build frontend app
tasks.command: cd frontend/job-portal && npm install && npm run build

tasks.label: Start backend server
tasks.command: cd backend && npm install && node server.js

tasks.label: Validate backend syntax
tasks.command: cd backend && node --check server.js && node --check controllers/userController.js

tasks.label: Validate frontend
tasks.command: cd frontend/job-portal && npm run build && npm run lint
